candidates.contract_code:
pub assume_specification<T>[ Box::<[T]>::new_uninit_slice ](
    len: usize,
) -> (res: Box<[MaybeUninit<T>]>)
    ensures
        res@.len() == len,
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < res@.len() ==> res@[i].mem_contents().is_uninit(),
;
candidates.rationale: The slice view expresses the source-guaranteed length, and vstd's MaybeUninit mem_contents model expresses that every element is initially uninitialized.
risks: Allocation identity and OOM behavior are unmodeled
